annotations.title: Tabular CSV/JSON RAG Sanitizer & Formula-Injection Guard API

description: Tabular CSV/JSON RAG Sanitizer & Formula-Injection Guard API: Neutralize CSV formula injection, redact cell-level PII, and convert tables into RAG-ready Markdown & row chunks. (Endpoint: POST /v1/tabular-rag-cleaner)

check_prompt_injection.description: Scan cells for indirect prompt-injection instructions hidden in table data.

csv.description: Raw CSV, TSV, or semicolon-delimited table text.

delimiter.description: Column delimiter for raw text input (default 'auto').

normalize_decimals.description: When delimiter is ';' (or auto-detected ';'), normalize standalone European decimal commas (e.g. '1,5') to dots ('1.5').

redact_pii.description: Redact PII (emails, phones, IBANs, credit cards, national IDs) inside cells.

rows.description: Optional structured JSON array of row objects instead of raw CSV text.

sanitize_formulas.description: Neutralize CSV/spreadsheet formula injection payloads (=, +, -, @, DDE commands) by prefixing an apostrophe.

name: tinplate_tabular_rag_cleaner
